forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune from behavior seeds

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_replay: failure-mode diagnosis for controlled-fusion candidate proof washout
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies whether the M946 failure is alpha overshoot, current-family rejected-history washout, old-key stale diagnostic, or a deeper controlled-fusion branch conflict
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process and proof audit only; no training, no PPO, no promotion, no generalization claim
stop_condition: stop if the failure is explained by a known wrong-history branch washout
stop if the source-diverse failures show the same row family
stop if the route requires a new objective or a lower-alpha replay gate
fallback_plan: if alpha overshoot is likely, route to lower-alpha replay gate design using M944 backup candidates
if rejected-history branch washout is dominant, route to rejected-branch retention objective design
if controlled-fusion surface is fundamentally conflicting, route to branch synthesis
if diagnostics are stale, route to replay-surface refresh
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M946 proof_washout on one public replay surface plus source-diverse diagnostic failures

hypothesis: M946 failed because the M944 controlled-fusion direction improves normal margins while moving a current-family rejected/wrong-history branch across the collision boundary.
success_criteria: next route is selected without training or PPO
failure_criteria: audit cannot identify a concrete failing row family
